title: Why Do Maps Lie a Little?
hook: Earth is a ball. A paper map is flat.
narration: Earth is a ball. A paper map is flat.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Maps Lie a Little.
Flattening a ball stretches some countries.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Greenland looks huge on some maps. It is not that huge.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Earth is a ball. A paper map is flat.
The pictures today are a new earth world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do maps lie a little.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
